goal.request: Strengthen the visual-semantic data and candidate pack from the referenced natural-environment keyword research with detailed authoritative research, observable relations, confusion boundaries, fail-closed hard profiles, and regression coverage.

evidence.claim: The referenced conversation supplied a broad cross-sphere natural-environment vocabulary spanning landforms water ecosystems atmosphere cryosphere weather time season light texture processes hazards biomes ecotones and scene composition axes.

Twelve authoritative source-bound records support twelve relational environment grammars, eight still-image hard profiles, four candidate-only grammars, explicit confusion substitutes, and non-inference limits.

The merged runtime contains 75 new candidates across seven slots, twelve research mixins, and eight complete visual profiles; dictionary validation, whitespace validation, and scene-expression audit pass.

Twelve narrow English concept phrases route to exactly one intended mixin, eight exact phrases route to one intended hard profile, broad nature terms stay non-hard, paired visual confounds remain non-hard, and four process-heavy grammars remain candidate-only.

The integrated semantic index validates at 7443 candidate entries and the visual profile index validates at 170 profiles and 1003 exact terms; 25 retrieval and candidate-expansion tests plus 100 subtests pass.

A wider integrated run produced six unrelated failures because the concurrently added clinical_nursing_duty_system route activates on yandere nursing fixtures; no failure names a natural-environment candidate mixin or profile, so that unrelated work was preserved rather than edited.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: A selected natural environment is expressed as one observable system whose required materials structures spatial order contacts and process traces remain jointly visible, while age chemistry legal status long-term change hidden connectivity and ecological performance remain unclaimed.

invariants.statement: Every hard natural-environment profile has four required component groups, four matching evidence fields, five pixel-review gates, and at least five explicit substitutes that cannot pass.
Only eight grammars whose component relations are jointly judgeable in one still receive hard profiles; riparian hydrothermal mangrove and coral-reef process grammars remain candidate-only.
Exact researched phrases may activate new hard profiles, while generic forest wetland glacier desert volcano storm reef and nature terms remain discovery context only.

A generated still cannot certify ecosystem age legal delineation hydroperiod rock chemistry underground connection flow rate wind speed storm severity elevation climate trend species identity or ecological function.

flexible_dimensions: camera angle that preserves required ordering
lens and crop outside required visibility
time of day and season when they do not erase the target relation
presence or absence of people outside the environment owner

mismatches.source_state: The conversation distinguishes spheres landforms hydrology vegetation climate processes ecotones and foreground-to-background composition axes.
mismatches.render_state: A flat inventory of forest river mountain cloud and mood labels cannot preserve the causal and spatial relations that distinguish environment systems.

mismatches.source_state: Hydrology erosion deposition transport flow ecological trapping and long-term transition are processes with both visible traces and hidden or temporal components.
mismatches.render_state: A prompt or evaluator can overclaim the whole process from one familiar cue such as mud steam roots coral snow or lightning.

mismatches.source_state: Generic environment terms should permit broad creative interpretation.
mismatches.render_state: Binding every generic word to a detailed all-of contract would silently change unrelated prompts and create false failures.

hypotheses.statement: Decomposing an environment into subject action location surface composition and selective weather candidates preserves its causal spatial structure better than adding many near-synonymous scenery tags.
hypotheses.falsifier: One or more of the 75 candidates is not owned by its research mixin, or a narrow phrase fails to materialize at least six coordinated environment slots.

hypotheses.statement: Restricting hard profiles to jointly visible multi-component systems reduces false pixel claims without removing process-rich candidate support.
hypotheses.falsifier: A candidate-only riparian hydrothermal mangrove or coral phrase creates a hard profile, or an eight-profile exact phrase fails to activate its intended contract.

hypotheses.statement: Keeping generic nature words advisory preserves existing prompt freedom while precise research phrases opt into the detailed relation contract.
hypotheses.falsifier: A held-out broad term activates any new mixin or hard profile, or paired visual substitutes activate a natural-environment hard profile.

intervention.general_rule: Translate broad natural-environment research into relation-owned candidates, selective all-of visual profiles, narrow activation phrases, explicit confusion substitutes, and non-inference limits; do not let one familiar object or label substitute for the complete visible system.
intervention.generalization_basis: The same object-structure-process-context separation applies across forest wetland river coast karst glacier dune hydrothermal cloud treeline mangrove and coral environments.

decision.rationale: Source-bound candidate data, exact and negative routing, candidate-only separation, dictionary and generated-index consistency, scene-expression audit, and held-out retrieval regressions pass for the natural-environment scope. No image was rendered and no user visual judgment was collected, so pixel fidelity and aesthetic acceptance remain explicitly unscored. Six wider-suite failures belong to a preserved concurrent clinical-nursing route and do not support or weaken the natural-environment claim.
